Title: 499344-2026: France – Building conversion – Rehabilitation works for the Conservatoire Place Saint-Jean in St-Omer
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Renovation of a listed conservatory with an almost 200-seat auditorium and large rehearsal rooms is a large, complex cultural building and therefore of interest for sbp. Deduction because no specific structural engineering services are mentioned and because the project is located in France (not the DACH region).
titel: Renovation works at the Conservatoire Place Saint-Jean in Saint-Omer
kurzbeschreibung: Renovation of a listed conservatory with auditorium, structural repair and energy upgrade.
umfang: Renovation and conversion of a listed conservatory in the historic city centre. Planned measures include the remediation of structural damage, acoustic upgrading, energy renovation to the BBC rénovation Effinergie label, and conversion into a multipurpose music and theatre venue with an auditorium with around 200 seats, two large halls for collective use and additional teaching and ancillary rooms. Tendered as 18 lots, including hazardous material remediation, shell construction and structural strengthening, timber structure and slate roof, façades, fit-out and technical trades.
leistungen: Construction works in individual lots; in particular hazardous material remediation, demolition, site installation, shell construction, structural repair, timber structure and roofing, façade works, joinery, metal construction, interior fit-out, floor and wall coverings, painting works.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• The contract primarily concerns construction execution in specialist lots, not planning or structural design services.
• Positive aspects are the reference to structural strengthening, listed existing building and timber structure.
• The project is a cultural building with an auditorium and is therefore architecturally demanding in principle.
• For sbp, however, it is only of limited relevance, as no explicit engineering or structural design services are tendered.
• The award criterion price with 60 percent dominates, which further reduces the strategic attractiveness.
baukosten_erklaerung: Taken from the contract notice; estimated total value excluding VAT for the tendered construction works.
honorar_erklaerung: No planning fee stated; these are construction works in specialist lots. A reliable fee for sbp cannot therefore be derived.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Proof of professional indemnity insurance or bank declaration; indication of the average annual number of employees and management staff over the last three years; list of comparable works carried out over the last five years with certificates of proper execution; turnover figures for the last three financial years, minimum turnover according to the tender documents; depending on the lot, specific Qualibat or Qualifelec certifications or equivalent references, including for Lot 4 Qualibat 2391, 2392, 3132; Lot 5 Qualibat 2194; Lot 6 Qualibat 3552; Lot 7 Qualibat 4412; Lot 8 Qualibat 4322, 4343; Lot 9 Qualibat 4112, 4132, 4211; Lot 10 Qualibat 6312, 6341; Lot 11 Qualibat 6111; Lot 12 Qualifelec E2; Lot 13 Qualibat 5111, 5112.
zuschlagskriterien: Quality or technical value 40 percent; price 60 percent.
auftraggeber: COMMUNAUTE D'AGGLOMERATION DU PAYS DE SAINT-OMER, Saint-Omer, France; E-mail: correspondre@aws-france.com; Procurement platform: https://www.marches-publics.info
notes: Amendment notice to an open procedure. Estimated construction period 27 months from approximately 16.11.2026. Site visit mandatory for all lots except Lot 17. The project concerns a building listed in the register of historic monuments. Lot 19 signage will be awarded separately at a later date. EU and other public co-financing mentioned.
